{{Top|ga}} {{Droid |type=Corporate |image=[[File:1933-EpI.png]] |name=1933 |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[32 BBY]], [[Naboo]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which includes 1933's [[death]] on [[Naboo]], to [[32 BBY]]. |creator= |manufacturer= |line=[[B-series battle droid]]{{Film|I}} |model=[[B1-series battle droid]] |class=[[Battle droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.93 [[meter]]s{{Databank|battle-droid|Battle Droid}} establishes that all [[B1-series battle droid]]s were 1.93 [[meter]]s in height, while [[Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine 1|''Star Wars Jedi Master'' Magazine 1]] states that they weighed 65 [[kilogram]]s. |mass=65 [[kilogram]]s |gender= |pronouns= |sensor=[[Color|Black]] |plating=[[Bone]]-white |armament=[[E-5 blaster rifle]] |equipment=[[Comlink booster pack]] |affiliation=*[[Trade Federation]] **[[Trade Federation Droid Army]] }} {{Quote|There are too many of them.''"
"''That won't be a problem.|Quarsh Panaka and Qui-Gon Jinn, after noticing 1933 and the other battle droids in the hangar.|audio=Panaka-Jinn-TooMany-TPM.flac|}} '''1933''' was a [[B1-series battle droid]] who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY]], after the Federation [[Capture of Theed|captured]] the [[capital]] [[city]] [[Theed]], 1933 was positioned in the [[Theed Hangar]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[OOM command battle droid]] [[2163]]. While guarding the [[Naboo Royal Starship]] and holding members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] captive, the [[battle droid]] was [[Death|destroyed]] by [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], ultimately allowing the [[Jedi]] to board the [[starship]] and escape the planet with [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and her entourage. ==Biography== ===Capturing Theed=== {{Quote|We must accelerate our plans. Begin landing your troops.|[[Darth Sidious]], ordering Nute Gunray to invade Naboo|audio=AccelerateOurPlans-TPM.flac|}} [[File:Jinn-2163.png|thumb|left|300px|1933 (second droid from the right) stands by 2163 as the latter speaks with Qui-Gon Jinn.]] A [[B1-series battle droid]], 1933 served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army|droid army]] of the [[Trade Federation]]. In [[32 BBY]], the [[B-series battle droid|battle droid]] was utilized in the Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]], deployed to its surface by the corporation's [[Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray]], as part of its [[droid]] [[army]]. After the Federation [[Capture of Theed|gained control]] over the [[capital]] [[city]] [[Theed]], 1933 and multiple other B1 [[battle droid]]s under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[OOM command battle droid]] [[2163]] were stationed in the [[Theed Hangar]], where they guarded the [[Naboo Royal Starship]]. The B1 battle droids droids stationed in the [[hangar]] also guarded several members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]], including [[pilot]]s from the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps|Space Fighter Corps]], who were placed in a group on the ground and were surrounded by the droids. While the Federation held the pilots in custody, 1933 stood alongside 2163 and three other B1 units, including [[7169]], by the [[Entry ramp|boarding ramp]] to the [[starship]]. As they guarded the starship, however, [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], entered and led [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo and her entourage, including her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaidens]], [[Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka]], the [[Gungan]] [[Exile (punishment)|outcast]] [[Jar Jar Binks]], and several [[Naboo Palace Guard|Palace Guards]], into the hangar. ===Beheaded by a Jedi=== {{Quote|Where are you taking them?''"
"''To Coruscant.''"
"''Coruscant? Uh, that doesn't compute. Uh, wait, uh, you're under arrest!|2163 and Qui-Gon Jinn, after the latter is halted in front of the droids|audio=2163-Jinn-Arrest-TPM.flac|}} [[File:Bisected-Droids.png|thumb|right|300px|1933 and 2163 are destroyed by Qui-Gon Jinn.]] Jinn steadily approached{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}} 1933 and the other droids, causing a brief moment of uncertainty between the battle droids as the [[Jedi]] moved into their positions. While Jinn approached the droids, 2163 ordered the Jedi Master to halt. Upon being stopped, Jinn explained to the droid his role as an [[ambassador]] of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and his intention of transporting the [[queen]] and her entourage to the Republic capital planet [[Coruscant]]. Unable to understand the answer, 2163 ordered the arrest of Jinn and his allies. Before the droids were able to execute their orders and raise their [[blaster]]s, however, Jinn activated his [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and [[Death|bisected]] 2163 in one swing, beheading 1933 in the process. While the remaining battle droids were destroyed, Kenobi freed the captive pilots and security force members. Afterward, the Jedi, the queen, and their allies proceeded to board the Royal Starship, which they used to escape the occupied city and planet. ==Characteristics== A B1-series battle droid, 1933 stood at 1.93 [[meter]]s in height and was sixty-five [[kilogram]]s in weight. The battle droid also possessed [[bone]]-[[Color|white]] plating and black [[sensor]]s. ==Equipment== As a B1-series droid, 1933 was armed with an [[E-5 blaster rifle]] as well as a [[comlink booster pack]] attached to its back. The [[comlink]] booster pack was imprinted with the droid's designation, written in [[Trade Federation Script]]. ==Behind the scenes== 1933 was introduced in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. While not spoken in the film, the droid's designation was displayed on its comlink booster pack. ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *[[The Phantom Menace (French junior novelization)|''The Phantom Menace'' French junior novelization]] {{Po}} *[[The Phantom Menace Read-Along Storybook and CD|''The Phantom Menace'' Read-Along Storybook and CD]] {{Po}} *{{StoryCite|story=Escaping Naboo|book=The Prequel Trilogy Stories|audiobook=1}} {{Po}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|technology|battledroid|battle droid}} {{Po}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] {{C|Wreckage only}} *{{Databank|battle-droid|Battle Droid}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of 1933}} {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Trade Federation]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
